description: This source file defines an abstract base class `StyleAndFormatRenderer` responsible for rendering style and formatting attributes for document objects in RTF format within the MigraDoc PDF generation library. It manages style application, including character styles, and handles rendering of paragraph formatting and borders.

classes.name: StyleAndFormatRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class that provides mechanisms to render style and formatting attributes for document objects like paragraphs and cells, handling style determination, rendering, and cleanup after content has been rendered.

methods.name: RenderStyleAndFormat
methods.description: Renders style and formatting settings for a document object, including style application, paragraph formatting, and character styles when applicable.

methods.name: EndStyleAndFormatAfterContent
methods.description: Marks the end of style and formatting rendering, particularly closing content blocks started during style rendering.
